plan.name: Strategy 1: Systematic Cabinet Search and Cool in Fridge
plan.strategy: Search all cabinets in order from 1 to 6 to locate the mug, then cool it in the fridge before placing it in the coffeemachine.
steps: If the mug is not in cabinet 1, check cabinet 2.
Continue checking cabinets 3 through 6 in order.
Once the mug is found, cool it in the fridge.
After cooling, move the mug to the coffeemachine.
